Other named controls remain separate and use instruction priority. Companion targets use the explicitly proposed attached-phase and repeat-save bridge. No harm-ending clause is added.

NEW ORDER DELIVERY: Apply DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02. Same-plane conscious one-way issuance grants no location/senses or cross-plane mental network. Eligibility was actual Humanoid at application only; later identity-preserving body change does not silently replace it. A new cast may replace the old controller only after its own failed-save hard component genuinely establishes with an unspent eligible source-character/target/encounter guard. A saved, immune, suppressed-before-establishment or guard-blocked cast replaces nothing and never refunds old history. The companion bridge uses original owner structure and a same-companion/same-phase pending reservation only; no caster creates an unwilling owner BA or steals another companion's reservation.

CONCENTRATION/REPLACEMENT DISTINCTION: the failed-establishment no-replacement rule does not protect a caster's old concentration from that same caster starting a new concentration spell. Ordinary commitment ends the incompatible old concentration before resolution, with no restoration on a later successful save or blocked hard component. Another caster's failed attempt does not by itself displace the original caster's concentration.

completeSharedRules.status: NEW complete current local DE4 proposal only; original shared proposal retained separately. No adopted rule or source is changed.
completeSharedRules.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
completeSharedRules.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
completeSharedRules.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. Current accepted expedition/faction procedures now supply their actual records and social limits. This spell proposal grants no membership, standing, allied status, permission, roster or institution merely by requesting information.
completeSharedRules.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
completeSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
completeSharedRules.DE4-GUARD-01: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.
completeSharedRules.DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02: NEW spell-specific proposal for Seal Vision only. In creature mode use the protected actual body; in area mode a body is protected when any actual portion is within the20ft sphere and has center LoE, and a discrete spatial magical expression is protected at its actual source-defined locus. No whole-plane, body-independent soul or remote caster concentration locus is inferred. For an ongoing body-target Divination buff/mark, suspend that target component while protected, preserve identity/deadline/history, and resume only a still-existing component when protection ends. For a pending personal Divination permission, an actually protected/suppressed holder cannot activate that permission. For a Divination-created Fate Coin inside the area, retain the actual same physical coin/HP/custody/deadline while disabling its magical reroll use; do not create material or destroy it merely from this spell suppression. Prevent an actually blocked new Divination component from establishing; no deferred component appears when protection later ends. For a reroll use whose own source remains operative, separately test the actual original roll-generating creature/object or source-defined local event. Protecting one recipient of an independently generated shared damage pool does not split or selectively reroll that pool, and ordinary indirect consequences retain their original source school. The original roll generator/event is fixed by the actual source before a reroll; it is not the rendered RNG animation position or a convenient alternative victim. If a source leaves that generator genuinely undefined, resolve and record that ambiguity before claiming a legal protected/unprotected example. Known non-operative permission is unusable without expenditure. An otherwise legal operative permission committed against a protected original roll event is spent under its real source and common guard, but its blocked Divination alteration produces no replacement; the unchanged original result resolves. This latter paid-block distinction is explicit NEW local authorship requiring joint review. No information-only ward becomes general antimagic.
completeSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. No additional maintained range or shared language/hearing is required; no perceptions/location/knowledge flow back. Protection against an actual information-gathering source does not by itself cancel this noninformational channel. A genuinely issued valid order retains its ordinary opportunity and exact expiry if the target is subsequently relocated; a later failed new issuance creates no replacement. This does not transport the target, permit an unsafe route or compel optional resource use. Dominate Person uses the future START/actual attached-phase opportunity, so it does not grant an advance stored order outside those specific source timings. Compulsion stores a fixed world-space direction on its actual application plane. If the target is on another plane at its sole execution opportunity, the direction instruction has no executable route and expires without refund or delayed retry; no universal cross-plane compass relation is invented. Same-plane relocation keeps the recorded world direction, not a new vector to the caster.
completeSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. On a failed Phantasmal Killer application with a legally established damage component, create that recipient/application damage root before its first packet and snapshot the actual caster dealer's current unsuppressed Null Veil. The Illusion immediate packet and all later scheduled packets of that application descend from this one root, even if its initial round exposure was already spent and no initial packet resolved. Later Veil changes never rewrite this root. A genuinely new spell application, including a separate Enchantment immediate hit, creates a new root and checks the then-current caster state. Allocating a root is not damage, a hit, a Wound, a kill, a resource event or a claimed periodic exposure. Use actual scheduled recipient lifecycles, death saves and preexisting-source timing; a companion phase is not a new regular turn.
completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
completeSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.
completeSharedRules.DE4-PRESENTATION-06:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

completeRecord.procedure: Action; one perceived creature within60feet and line of effect; V/S/F; concentration up to60seconds. KEEP any creature with actual documented CR at most10 and WIS save each turn. NEW require a real numerical CR in the current operative creature/form profile, not character level, expedition tier, name, apparent size or an invented PC-to-CR conversion. A creature without such a CR is ineligible; a real form change before resolution uses the operative profile then. Resolve hidden CR after paid commitment. An eligible creature makes initial WIS; success gives no control. Failure attempts a non-Charmed hard action-control application under the shared guard; a blocked component gives no fallback. Eligibility is application-only; later same-creature type/CR changes alone do not end established control. At each future regular target START after mandatory start processing, a conscious capable caster may issue one mental order without another Action/BA, directing that opportunity's ordinary movement and one ordinary Action. No language/hearing is required and no remote senses or legality diagnostics are supplied. No valid new order means ordinary agency; an order is not automatically repeated. At each actual affected regular END, including an already-underway current turn, the target repeats WIS; success ends this application. Extra turns add neither order nor save. The target/controller chooses legal unspecified details. Ordinary Attack uses its real native ordinary attack sequence and normal ammunition, but no compelled spell/RP, charged/recharge/per-rest ability, special expendable ammunition, consumable magic or optional rider. No direct self-harm, knowingly suicidal route, private secret disclosure, permanent property surrender or knowing binding-oath/duty violation. BA, Reaction and separately granted extra Actions remain the target's own. Use current companion execution for an attached body and ordinary earliest-instruction priority for conflicting compulsions; changing controller never creates another owner cap or free attack. Independent applications retain separate casters/deadlines/END saves and shared history; a successful save clears only its own application. Caster incapacity normally ends concentration; target death, actual removal or expiry ends the application. Ordinary damage adds no unprinted repeat save.

Specify initial save and exact repeat-save marker, commands and communication, issue/change costs, target action/movement/reaction/resource permissions, unsafe or self-destructive orders, standing orders and unavailable commands. findings.finding: Catalog up-to3RP and Core5RP disagree. The old proposal deliberately chooses3 while retaining a7RP cast and20HP cost; its once-beneficial-rest restriction is also new.
findings.nextStep: Show both complete source values and actual cost arithmetic; ask GPT for an explicit choice and useful intended behavior before current authorship.

findings.finding: The proposal makes full-HP recovery a direct state operation. Existing healing distinctions support separating operation types, but do not themselves authorize Grave Gift to bypass Critical or independently stabilize.
findings.nextStep: Confer on both components, actual willing recipient, 31→16 and2→1 donor costs, broad prohibition and unchanged Wounds/Stable deadline. Preserve the full former procedure.

findings.finding: Full suppression is not uniform: Golem/Wraith/Homunculus end; Knight suspends absent; Flood/Danse keep inert real bodies; Create Undead keeps its active body while authority is suppressed.
findings.nextStep: Review each exact rule. Do not generalize accepted pet suppression to these pending spells. Supply real antimagic locus, deadline, body/cargo and placement traces.

findings.finding: Animation consumes one actual body allocation without duplicating gear, donors or remains. Flood proposes a post-immediate-response claim before a later Auto-Raise checkpoint; Danse/Create Undead propose distinct admission and duration rules.
findings.nextStep: Bind real damage/lifecycle and actually eligible corpse provenance. A newly0 surviving significant NPC, already consumed body, copied summon and reconstructed living identity must not be treated as the same eligible corpse case.

findings.finding: The four newly proposed animations are explicitly unrated. Source-only bestiary rows do not constitute operative creature approval, and no appearance or another class companion profile proves exactCR2.
findings.nextStep: Keep CR2 examples conditional unless an actual individually approved complete creature profile exists. Decide exact2 versus≤2 explicitly against both printed sources.

findings.finding: The cap limits creator control relations, not surviving permanent bodies. Repeated paid casts with new corpses and declared releases can leave arbitrarily many independent animations over time.
findings.nextStep: Ask whether that consequence is intentional; if so, define retained needs, agency, scheduling and ownership through actual rules. Do not silently add a world population cap or guaranteed hostility.

findings.finding: IN6-07-A supplies17 post-defense necrotic and5temp+7normal actual loss, but lacks a complete real Cleric build, attack/dice, target lifecycle, transfer tree and healing modifiers. Its numeric12→6→3 remains a valid conditional arithmetic obligation.
findings.nextStep: Preserve that arithmetic; add actual source-qualified full case. A new funding exclusion for created/animated bodies must not rewrite accepted Vampiric Touch or Soul Tap.

findings.finding: 15ft wall travel costs30 fromFly40 only when the actual route is legal. Forced expulsion, no-entry-path fallback, fully obstructed placement and real cargo need explicit deterministic finite geometry.
findings.nextStep: Preserve the30/10 movement obligation. Avoid gear teleportation to a distant last-open point after arbitrary later movement, and specify the actual position/departure record used.

findings.finding: Permanent non-Charmed whole-Action restriction claims hard admission once; existing companion chassis and independent actors use different schedules. Caster death creates an absent binder phase, not a new automatic turn.
findings.nextStep: Review ordinary agency while suppressed, next unresolved regular opportunity, original-owner structural reservations, competing orders, release and refusal/resource limits as separate state transitions.

findings.finding: A new2RP Action touch repair is not ordinary organic healing or automatic Mending permission. An unskilled servant standing chore must not silently satisfy real recipe assistants, crew attendance or valuable production.
findings.nextStep: Bind legal repair scope, two real dice totaling8, actual class RP, a real fitted container/lantern, capacity and actual EX58 work rules. Preserve7→15/20 and no salvage/gear reset.

findings.finding: The old rank5 shared baseline raises Dissonance to1 on a fresh ordinary cast. The current Wizard first-distinct prepared-spell rule instead has the exact accepted source cadence; old baseline text is historical evidence.
findings.nextStep: Rebuild all20 current cases with actual class/school/acquisition, RP, cadence, HP, real Action/Bonus Action, geometry and source-qualified ownership. Preserve every original scenario ID/text.

findings.finding: Golem Slow Aura replaces Slam; Flood/Danse use a new20HP zombie rather than Wizard standard minions; Create Undead has four complete distinct new profiles. Creation-round permission differs by source.
findings.nextStep: Discuss every profile and round gate, actual native anatomy/armor, source DC snapshot/current distinctions and command channel without importing external-game monster rules.

CL10-CAST-01.scope: These ten ordinary spells; no source/catalog rewrite
CL10-CAST-01.completeText:
Keep each complete current source/access object and every original Core/catalog entry unchanged. The catalog's actual class-school placement, rank and minimum class level must be paired with a real learned/prepared repertoire. A source-only access row does not supply the rest of an unsupplied class engine. No union of another class's schools is allowed. Universal Create Homunculus remains Universal; Necromancy remains Necromancy. No named material, blood, corpse, gem or monetary component is inferred from a title. Golem and Danse retain V/S/M-F evidence; the inherited focus alternative is usable without inventing consumed materials.

All ten have an Action casting time and printed 60-foot range. Preserve that range as evidence even where Soulburn's proposed self-only recovery narrows its operation. Base RP is 7 at rank 4, 10 at rank 5 and 13 at rank 6. Apply only actual accepted price rules and acquired class exceptions. Quote and pay before ordinary counter/interrupt resolution; a future recovered pool cannot fund that quotation. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.title: Created companions, ownership and stat provenance
CL10-COMMAND-01.classification: INHERITED command/stat rules; NEW named asset caps and creation-round policies
CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. Cleric Healing Rite requires a living ally, and the scoped AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally extensions do not include these new bodies. This conference does not extend that predicate. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. Re-expression does not automatically reclaim dropped gear. A suppressed field can still contain the pending pose; it cannot resume merely by asking for an outside square. If source/clock ends first, nothing is re-created. A legal unsupported re-expression starts the actual Falling rules.

Flood and Danse keep their actual consumed physical bodies and real carried gear in place while their sustaining animation is suppressed. Suppressed animation supplies no voluntary movement, offense or command execution; gravity, ordinary collision/support, externally inflicted effects and absolute clocks remain real. Their eventual hour/zero/dispel/dismissal ending leaves the same consumed remains, not a fresh corpse. Create Undead is different again: permanent physical conversion is not undone by dispelling/suppressing its separate authority relation. Suppression of authority restores the body's underlying real independent agency; it does not grant an extra opportunity or free loyalty. Any independently magical native action/rider remains subject to the actual field on its own terms. Command Undeath similarly suppresses control, not an existing body's physical existence.

NEW limited geometric completion: when accepted Lesser Antimagic intersects any part of the actual expressed body of Golem, Knight, Wraith, Homunculus, Flood zombie or Danse zombie, treat that named body's sustaining expression as fully suppressed for the lifecycle above. This extends no other spell or field and grants no immunity to merely partial-body intersections. For a temporarily absent Knight test the saved expression volume. Local suppression of Create Undead/Command Undeath authority is tested at the actual bound body's volume; it changes authority, not permanent flesh. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.

CL10-ORDER-01.title: Command Undeath and released permanent bodies
CL10-ORDER-01.classification: NEW Command-Undeath/Create-Undead-only schedule and agency completion
CL10-ORDER-01.scope: No extension of DE4 domination to other sources
CL10-ORDER-01.completeText:
Choose Q14 option B: an already independent bound creature keeps its actual pre-binding initiative position and regular opportunities. Do not migrate it to the binder's attached phase. An existing companion keeps its actual original owner's attached phase and all source-owner stats/slots. Binding, suppression, release, death of a controller and return from suppression do not create an immediate turn, refresh a used Action/Reaction, replay START/END hooks or reset a recharge. The exact actual owner or independent schedule must be bound before a current worked fixture can be claimed complete.

While Command Undeath is operative, its non-Charmed permanent restriction permits only defensive movement/Dodge without a valid command. On the binder's actual regular turn, a Bonus Action through the spell's 60-foot same-plane perceived/LoE command channel can queue one bounded order for one target's next actual future behavior opportunity. A turn already underway is not a future opportunity. The order expires at that single opportunity whether executed, suppressed, invalid, impossible or budget-starved, or at the binder's next regular START or issuance+6 actual seconds, whichever occurs first. The six-second cap is a NEW Command-Undeath-only absolute order expiry, not a new lifetime for the permanent relation. Only one pending order per binder-target exists; it cannot be banked through absence or suppression. Reaching a deadline that is also a possible execution point expires it first under the actual ordered phases. A successfully heard order does not create an ongoing remote channel: later plane separation can prevent new issue, not supply new knowledge or alter the already fixed instruction.

The issuing Bonus Action consumes the actual owner-wide command allowance of its issuance round. At execution the binder's owner-wide offensive allowance for that execution round must also be unused and is consumed once; a command that crosses a round boundary neither duplicates an offensive allowance nor refunds its prior command. For a source-owned companion, both binder's and original owner's structural allowance for that body/phase must be satisfied. Reuse an existing reservation only for the same body, same phase and same offensive opportunity; do not charge an unwilling owner a new Bonus Action or reserve another companion's attack. The absent original owner supplies no invented attached action phase. Resolve genuinely competing source-qualified directives under actual applicable ordering; this proposal does not grant authority to override another named source's explicit priority.

A valid instruction can use the body's actual movement and one ordinary Action, including a native inherent Multiattack only when the bound profile really has it. It does not force optional finite-resource powers, spellcasting, expended charges/recharges, new Bonus Actions/Reactions, secrets, prohibited oaths, item surrender or a suicide operation. Mandatory ordinary ammunition/material expenditure of an otherwise legal ordinary attack still needs the actual item; an instruction creates none. Type/obedience is not a source of private knowledge. Range and LoE for an executed attack are measured from the actual acting body, not the binder. No order changes donor or soul identity.

Suppressed Command control restores ordinary underlying agency at the same real scheduled opportunity; no instruction is performed while the control is suppressed and none replays later. When control resumes, restore the still-live relation and future defensive-only restriction without repeating its already-admitted hard-control save. Actual target death ends that relation; caster death alone does not, but a dead/absent/incapacitated binder cannot issue legal orders. The caster can release its own relation on its actual regular turn without an Action. It grants no automatic loyalty, hostility, faction membership or property ownership afterward.

For Create Undead only, losing/suppressing/replacing creator authority leaves the permanent actual body alive in its current animation state. On first independent agency, preserve that numbered round's spent opportunity and creation-round prohibition. Do not give an immediate action: place its next independent regular slot immediately after its former creator slot at that slot's next scheduled occurrence, using stable body-ID order for a group. If an old slot cannot recur because the owner has left the encounter, retain its captured virtual slot solely as a scheduling marker and assign an independent slot at the next actual encounter scheduling boundary; no retroactive turn is invented. Restoring authority retires that independent slot only prospectively into the creator's next genuinely available attached phase; at most one voluntary opportunity per round survives the transition. This is a NEW limited transition rule for these permanently created profiles, not a global controller/initiative rewrite.

Released bodies need actual NPC behavior/needs/context records before a autonomous-work/combat sequence can be claimed complete. Release is not a direction to attack, obey forever, donate HP, take a crew job or harvest another corpse. Two authority slots are not a world population cap. Repeated genuinely paid Create Undead casts with different eligible real corpses may accumulate independent bodies over time; no automatic service, material reward or free roster space follows.

Outside initiative, a released permanent body uses independent successive six-second opportunities beginning no earlier than its next unspent former cycle boundary; re-entering initiative maps that pending opportunity without replay or refresh. This defines timing only. It supplies no unreviewed NPC goal, ability, reaction budget, physiology or work permission.

records.completeProcedureFromActualConferenceUnc:
Summon Corpse Golem remains Necromancy rank 4, Action, 60 feet, base 7 RP, V/S/M-F and concentration up to one minute. Its printed HP60, 2d10 slam and slow aura all survive. NEW this is one generated temporary creature, not resurrection or assembly from actual corpse inventory. The name and material/focus alternative do not impose a corpse, soul, blood or unprinted price. Declare a perceived, supported, unoccupied Large 10x10 whole-body space within 60 feet and line of effect and bind its measured height before commitment. Pay the actual spell price and start concentration normally. Successful formation starts the same body's absolute 60-second deadline.

NEW complete bounded combat profile: Large mechanical Construct, base HP60, AC15, mass600 lb, walk20 feet, ordinary sight/hearing, no special vision. All six saves are original creating source-owner PB as the total bonus; other default untrained checks are +0. These are the inherited missing-stat fallback, not permission to invent a high attribute/proficiency. Two manipulators can carry genuinely fitting noncreature gear subject to a local maximum40 lb AND4Load, available hands and real fit. It has no fine artisan use, skill/tool proficiency, spell/resource pool, resistance, immunity, regeneration or extra natural weapon by type/name. Actual body height and needed environmental traits must be supplied in a future geometry/exposure fixture, not guessed from a two-foot box.

At its one legally commanded attached phase choose exactly one of two offensive Actions. Slam: one melee attack against an actually perceived target within 5 feet and LoE from the Golem's body, using original owner's current creating-class spell attack, dealing 2d10 bludgeoning with no ability add; attack critical uses 4d10. A true shared allowance must remain for this Golem, not another owned asset.

Slow Aura is the other offensive Action, not a free passive in addition to Slam. Establish a 10-foot radius centered on this same moving body with actual origin LoE, ending at the original source owner's next future regular START. At activation declare the finite actual enemy identities selected from opposition known to that owner/body; this supplies no hidden hostility detector or new information. Each selected creature already inside, or entering before that endpoint, makes one CON save against the actual casting DC snapshotted when the aura is activated. Success excludes that creature from this activation. Failure halves its Speed only while its body is within the live aura/LoE, under strongest-adverse-Speed arbitration. Leaving removes this aura's active modifier; re-entry restores that same failure without a second save. A later genuinely commanded activation has its own single-save record. The aura grants no Action loss, full Slow condition, hard-control claim, new attack or duplicated same-name slow. Body disappearance, incapacity where actual aura rules require consciousness, or suppression disables the aura; its original endpoint keeps running and it does not queue a later application.

There is one live Corpse Golem source per original caster. Formation does not itself attack; an available real creation-turn Bonus Action may command through CL10-COMMAND-01. Ordinary zero-HP destruction, expiry, concentration ending, actual removal or full sustaining-expression suppression ends it and the source's remaining aura, without corpse/XP/loot/harvest. Qualifying Null instead leaves the same extant body NullDisabled0 while the source persists; no dying/Wound/Stable engine is added and no generic organic-healing repair is granted. Independent ending/suppression still removes that disabled body. Real external cargo settles at the current actual location under legal item placement; intrinsic appearance creates no material stock.

It is a temporary summoned body with corpse-like appearance, not an animation of an actual dead identity; no corpse input, ownership or soul fact is inferred. Source-specific HP costs are real normal-HP costs, not damage, healing, temporary HP or a shareable packet. They cannot lower the payer below 1 HP. Countered or paid hidden-ineligible outcomes do not refund HP/RP or restore displaced concentration.

Use the accepted spell-commitment, Dissonance/Refrain and Ready rules, not a generic new sequence. The acquired Wizard matrix exception can change base Dissonance; it does not erase Refrain. Idle turns do not reset either. A readied spell pays/prepares and begins held concentration at preparation; its legal target/area is selected and checked at release. The particular effect's lifetime begins only at successful release/establishment. A separately source-authorized nonspell Action repair/readied technique has its own payment at actual execution, not an invented spell cast.

NEW spell-local durations retained for authoring: Corpse Golem, Death Knight and Soul Wraith require concentration and end 60 actual seconds after establishment. Flood/Danse animation bodies end 3,600 actual seconds after their successful formation and require no concentration. Their printed Instantaneous metadata describes establishment, not a rewrite of the original. Create Undead's physical conversion is permanent; its separate rank-six authority relation and Command Undeath last until their real removal. Homunculus's created body/control is persistent with the distinct endings stated below. Soulburn and Grave Gift resolve instantaneous components and create no upkeep duration. An outside-mode six-second cycle is a clock mapping, never an extra action. Absolute deadlines, true regular owner markers, body-source expiry and already-spent command resources never reset on suppression, healing, release, renaming or mode changes.

CL10-COMMAND-01.title: Created companions, ownership and stat provenance
CL10-COMMAND-01.classification: INHERITED command/stat rules; NEW named asset caps and creation-round policies
CL10-COMMAND-01.scope: Golem, Knight, Wraith, Flood/Danse zombies, Create Undead and Homunculus only
CL10-COMMAND-01.completeText:
Keep original creator, current controller, body identity and source application as distinct records. Original creator-derived spell attacks, DCs and saves use the actual original creating class record; a temporary controller does not lend a better casting modifier. A profile that says PB as the total save bonus does not also add its ability modifier. Profile attacks add no ability damage unless that particular attack prints it. Critical hits double eligible attack dice, not flat modifiers or a later independent saving-throw aura.

The acquired Wizard Conjuration creation bonus is tested against an actual creature created by that Wizard's spell, not against the creating spell's school label alone. Snapshot its +Wizard-level maximum HP at genuine qualifying creation. The separately acquired Flesh Ascendant bonus is the current eligible controlling Wizard's +2 per Wizard level where its actual controlled-Undead predicate passes. Preserve the accepted exception that permits those two distinct bonuses together and the single strongest eligible application of each named source; no alias duplication. Later maximum-HP changes use the accepted clamp/capacity rules and do not themselves heal. If the source-owner later dies, its extant class/stat record does not become zero or a different controller's statistics.

While creator-controlled, each capable named asset resolves only in the actual attached phase after the whole owner's regular turn. A paid Bonus Action on that regular turn directs at most one eligible asset. It uses the accepted owner-wide one-command allowance and, for offense, the one-offensive-asset allowance for that numbered round across pets, minions, devices and these spells. Do not grant an independent Reaction, an extra owner turn, a second command during an extra Action or a second offensive asset because spell/class asset caps differ. The commanded asset must satisfy its own position, perception, path and resource prerequisites when it resolves. An issued command is not refunded or replayed if that phase lacks a legal action. Lack of a valid command permits only the source's actual defensive movement/Dodge, not an attack, skilled task or resource use.

NEW source limits: one Corpse Golem, one Death Knight, one Soul Wraith and one Homunculus per original caster; one Flood body; one Danse cohort containing at most five; two Create Undead authority slots. These are separate from Wizard's three standard-minion slots, Ranger Beast, Mage elite slots, Mirror assets and the existing Expedition roster. They do not multiply the shared command/offense allowances. A successful replacement ends/replaces only that spell's indicated source/body/control record. A known cap replacement must be declared before commitment; a failed new establishment never selects a substitute, but starting new concentration has already ended an incompatible prior concentration.

Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus may use a genuine still-available creation-turn Bonus Action command and subsequent real attached phase; creation itself supplies no attack/task. NEW Flood, Danse and Create Undead forbid all voluntary acts in the numbered round of creation, including a bonus Dodge; outside initiative their first possible phase is the next genuine six-second cycle. The actual source lifespan starts at formation even while this prohibition applies. Creator incapacity alone does not retroactively cancel an already valid nonconcentration order; actual concentration ending or source/body loss does. An absent original owner supplies no fictitious attached phase. Command Undeath and release of a permanent Create Undead body use CL10-ORDER-01, not an invented owner-turn refresh.

CL10-BODY-01.title: Bodies, geometry, stock and incomplete facts
CL10-BODY-01.classification: INHERITED body/gear rules; explicit scope boundaries
CL10-BODY-01.scope: Only the named authored bodies; not a world physiology or environment engine
CL10-BODY-01.completeText:
Use Tiny 2.5-by-2.5-foot, Small/Medium 5-by-5-foot and Large 10-by-10-foot occupied horizontal spaces under the accepted body rule. A source body's measured height, current orientation, actual missing parts, body mass and supports are separate facts. No named class or ordinary Small/Medium Beast gets a two-foot combat body from [1,1,1]. A new scenario must print its actual body extents; numeric damage-only examples do not prove range, cone, collision, reach or close-quarters eligibility.

A created body's initial space must already fit, be unoccupied, be perceived/targetable within the source's real range and have the source-required support before casting. No future growth or creation expands the world to legalize a target. A corpse conversion occurs at its same actual physical anchor using current matter, not a free relocation to a convenient empty square. Voluntary size changes obey actual preflight. Mandatory source ending, death, reversion, body removal and release of melded cargo always happen; no body-reservation ward or whole external-event veto is created. Where this proposal explicitly calls canonical normalization, use same anchor, legal squeeze, then nearest legal adjacent space in the same unobstructed region, minimum displacement/greatest overlap/fixed neutral board tie, with no farther search or wall/occupant passage. Normalization spends no movement and creates no opportunity/charge/movement rider. Banishment's separately named conflict semantics are not imported.

All carried/worn items are real separate IDs. Apply actual physical-capacity AND Load limits, hand/slot/fit restrictions and Burdened penalties. A listed local smaller cargo limit adds a restriction; it does not cancel weight or Load. Genuine body parcels count as bodies under their source, never bundled equipment. Created intrinsic swords/wrappings/appearance have no independent harvestable stock. On actual body ending, real gear uses current-position legal item placement, nearest legal adjacent item placement or pending-placement state. No item jumps to a distant historical last-open square, and disappearance never recreates old cargo, repairs its condition or refills fuel.

Corpse-derived animations retain one consumed physical allocation, original body history, missing limbs, harvested parts, real gear and documented physiological/terrain requirements. Their fresh listed base HP is a new animation HP pool, not limb repair, Wound treatment, resurrection or corpse replenishment. No-breath/no-food/no-water/no-sleep, immunity, natural origin and soul status cannot be inferred from the Undead/Construct label. A permanent-body work/exposure scenario must bind the actual retained needs and applicable recovery rules; an unavailable need/profile fact remains an explicit input prerequisite, not an immunity. This conference gives no global corpse-decay or living-physiology engine. The newly generated finite manifestations and Homunculus likewise gain only their stated traits; source-dependent environmental use needs the actual required trait record.

Command Undeath's required CR is an authoritative mechanical profile field, not an appearance check or a derived result from these new HP values. All four Create Undead alternatives remain unrated. The complete frozen bestiary is a source-only record collection; no exact operative CR2 Undead is supplied. A positive Command fixture therefore remains conditional until a complete individually authorized eligible profile is bound.

CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.title: Damage roots, disabled bodies and valid healing
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.classification: INHERITED root/life order plus NEW limited animation lifecycle binding
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.scope: The seven created/animated-body spells here; no universal Undead healing grant
CL10-NULL-LIFE-01.completeText:
A creature attack creates its damage root at the actual accepted damage checkpoint, with that acting companion as dealer and the original creator retained separately as stat/source owner. Creator Veil does not automatically make a Golem/Knight/Wraith/zombie attack Null. Flood's ordinary spell packet has its caster as dealer. Separate attack events create separate roots; child packets inherit their parent flag; sharing preserves flags and never double-counts the parent and terminal branches. Apply the actual real damage, prevention, temporary HP, Wound/death and actual immediate-response sequence. Do not decide actual death just from reaching zero.

Qualifying Null damage uses the accepted ordered protection, including damage-caused Instant Death/Wound/Maiming/fatal-Wound exclusions and retained prior zero-state histories. It is not an HP-cost prevention, independent expiry immunity, resurrection or concentration immunity. Golem, Knight, Wraith and Homunculus bind their existing finite-created/Construct recipient branches: a qualifying Null packet taking the surviving body to zero, or hitting the same already-disabled body, records/preserves NullDisabled0 rather than ordinary damage-caused disappearance. This adds no living-ally target predicate, Wounds, death saves, Stable roll or rest regeneration to these HP-only profiles. Their own concentration, expiry, dismissal, replacement and suppression endings still happen.

NEW named extension: Flood zombies, Danse zombies and the four Create Undead bodies use the same finite or persistent consumed-animation principle for qualifying Null damage: preserve the same body/allocation, authority, HP0, gear and clocks in NullDisabled0; no fresh corpse destruction or resource trigger. This specifically binds these new profiles and does not relabel them as Wizard standard minions. Further qualifying Null damage neither destroys nor refreshes them. Independent authority/source ending, genuine non-Null damage causing the profile's ordinary zero/destroyed branch, or another actually applicable real ending remains effective. A living target of Flood instead uses its own real living/death-save/Beast lifecycle; Null preventing its death prevents Flood's zombie claim.

Legal positive restoration to the same extant disabled body clears only that zero-HP disabled state. It never refills a command, lifespan, ability, limb or inventory. Homunculus's explicit maintenance and Wraith's own self-lifetap are named permissions. Any other proposed repair/heal must supply an actual eligible target source. Cleric Healing Rite requires a living ally, and the scoped AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally extensions do not include these new bodies. This conference does not extend that predicate. A source with its own creature-only healing permission can be evaluated on its actual terms; Undead/Construct alone supplies neither immunity nor universal eligibility.

CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.title: Distinct suppression and terminal identity
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.classification: NEW source-local lifecycle choices constrained by accepted antimagic and life rules
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.scope: Only these named applications under the actual suppressing source; not a global field-size rule
CL10-SUPPRESSION-01.completeText:
Do not unify the bodies merely because they are summons. A full operational body-expression suppression ends Corpse Golem, Soul Wraith and Homunculus immediately with current-position real cargo settlement and no stored return. For Golem/Wraith this also ends that now-empty creating application; it does not resume when the field ends. A narrower suppressed attack/rider suppresses only its own expression unless the actual field also suppresses the body sustaining expression.

Death Knight instead temporarily has no expressed body. Record its actual current pose when suppression starts, same identity/HP/NullDisabled state/current maximum/source owner/spent allowances and absolute deadline. Real external gear drops there under existing item placement, and intrinsic shadow equipment produces nothing. The absent body provides no occupancy, cover, support, attack or sensory presence. When all applicable suppressors end while the source remains live, attempt to re-express that same body at the saved pose using the local canonical fitting procedure. An occupied saved pose is not a protected berth. If no local placement is legal, expression remains pending within the original source lifetime; no extra duration is granted. Re-expression does not automatically reclaim dropped gear. A suppressed field can still contain the pending pose; it cannot resume merely by asking for an outside square. If source/clock ends first, nothing is re-created. A legal unsupported re-expression starts the actual Falling rules.

Flood and Danse keep their actual consumed physical bodies and real carried gear in place while their sustaining animation is suppressed. Suppressed animation supplies no voluntary movement, offense or command execution; gravity, ordinary collision/support, externally inflicted effects and absolute clocks remain real. Their eventual hour/zero/dispel/dismissal ending leaves the same consumed remains, not a fresh corpse. Create Undead is different again: permanent physical conversion is not undone by dispelling/suppressing its separate authority relation. Suppression of authority restores the body's underlying real independent agency; it does not grant an extra opportunity or free loyalty. Any independently magical native action/rider remains subject to the actual field on its own terms. Command Undeath similarly suppresses control, not an existing body's physical existence.

NEW limited geometric completion: when accepted Lesser Antimagic intersects any part of the actual expressed body of Golem, Knight, Wraith, Homunculus, Flood zombie or Danse zombie, treat that named body's sustaining expression as fully suppressed for the lifecycle above. This extends no other spell or field and grants no immunity to merely partial-body intersections. For a temporarily absent Knight test the saved expression volume. Local suppression of Create Undead/Command Undeath authority is tested at the actual bound body's volume; it changes authority, not permanent flesh. These specific choices are proposed here, not inherited globally from the two AC5 or three AC6 families. Use their actual source family exception and spell-disruption rules without editing accepted AC5/AC6.

A suppressed queued command is spent/lost at its one genuine opportunity, not banked for resumption. Source expiry, real body death/removal and mandatory form endings are never vetoed by suppression. Direct removal uses the actual class/ordinary Dispel rank/cost/check and immutable operation rules. A Wizard rank-three class Dispel is not an ordinary rank-three Dispel by name, and Greater Dispel does not replay a previously suppressed removal merely because a suppressing field was ended in the same captured operation set.
